headline: GTA 6 comes 13 years after GTA 5
title: GTA 6 Comes 13 Years After GTA 5 | The Longest Wait in GTA History | GTA 6 News
video_script: GTA five came out on September seventeenth, twenty thirteen. GTA six comes out on November nineteenth, twenty twenty six. That is a gap of more than thirteen years, the longest wait between two main GTA games ever. GTA five went on to become one of the best-selling games of all time. Were you there for GTA five's launch? Comment below!
description: Grand Theft Auto V released on September 17, 2013; Grand Theft Auto VI releases on November 19, 2026 - more than 13 years later.
